description: Search official GOV.UK tax and business guidance. Use when the user asks "what does HMRC say about X?", asks about tax rules, filing requirements, or wants to know the official guidance on a topic like VAT, corporation tax, dividends, or director responsibilities.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

topic.description: The topic to search for, e.g. "VAT returns", "corporation tax", "dividends", "director loans", "expenses"

name: get_gov_guidance
title: Get Gov Guidance
